visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens outdoors at dusk in a street setting. A man with black hair wearing a white t-shirt and a grey crossbody bag holds a small Sasuke action figure. He gestures towards a black scooter parked behind him. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor studio filled with shelves of figurines and collectibles. The man stands behind a light wooden table and performs a close-up unboxing of the Sasuke toy. (3) The man attempts to balance a large black long-zippered wallet on the toy's outstretched hands. The wallet stays level. (4) The man places a large silver laptop on the toy. He looks at the camera with an expression of shock and amusement as it remains balanced. (5) The man brings a large black frying pan onto the table and carefully rests it on the toy. He claps his hands in success. (6) An orange electric rice cooker is placed on top of the toy. A close-up shows the toy's head and hands supporting the heavy base of the appliance. (7) Back outdoors at night, the man crouches next to the front wheel of the scooter. He attempts to wedge the action figure under the tire to support the weight of the vehicle. (8) Indoor living room setting. The man sits on a grey couch, now wearing a dark blue shirt. He holds a large white cartoon-style plush pillow and a yellow beverage carrier bag, demonstrating their features to the camera. (9) A screen recording of a website interface titled '微疼' shows product listings for the pillow and bags, followed by static shots of the merchandise on a chair and held by hands.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male voice begins speaking quickly over a bright, rhythmic electronic pop BGM. A subtle outdoor urban noise floor is audible. (2) A sharp 'Ding' SFX marks a cut. The speaker's tone is higher in pitch as he introduces the action figure. (3) A series of 'Pop' and 'Whoosh' SFX accompany the transition to the studio. Music continues at a steady 128 BPM. (4) As each object is balanced, a triumphant 'Stinger' SFX or a 'Ding' plays. The speaker exclaims in high-arousal joyful tones. (5) A recorded applause track and cheering sound effect trigger when the rice cooker is balanced. The music swells slightly in volume. (6) Heavy thud and metallic rustling sounds are heard as the scene moves back to the motorcycle. The vocal delivery becomes more straining and focused. (7) Transition to the couch segment. The BGM changes to a more relaxed, commercial-style jingle. The sound of fabric rustling and patting a pillow is prominent. (8) Clear, professional-grade vocal delivery as the speaker describes product features. Final 'Whoosh' SFX leads into the screen recording section.
